conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month growth, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while blending broad index and quality tech, offering a moderate risk/reward profile.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth, stretching for higher returns. It significantly increases both upside and drawdown potential due to higher leverage and concentration, and leveraged ETFs are subject to decay and rebalancing.
